_doc.purpose: The area names Malmö actually uses that no dataset has. Hand-edited; build-neighbourhoods.mjs only validates, places and resolves — it never invents an entry or rewrites your groupings.
why: Two official divisions exist and neither says what people say. The ten stadsdelar are too coarse (Västra Innerstaden) and the 136 delområden too fine (Ribersborg, Rönneholm, Kronprinsen) — the name in between, Slottsstaden, is in no dataset at all. Same for Limhamn, Hamnen, Sofielund, and for the small named quarters like Fullriggaren.
So this file holds the two ends the official data misses: groupings of delområden, and parts of one.

kinds.grouping: Has `covers`: the delområden it is made of, by exact name. Drawn at the neighbourhood level, where it replaces its members. Its shape is those polygons, so it needs no geometry of its own.
kinds.part: Has `within`: the delområde it sits inside, and a point. Drawn at the deepest zoom, below the delområde level. Smaller than any official area, so there is nothing to derive it from — the point is resolved once from Nominatim and then checked by hand.

fields.name: As it is said and as it will be shown.
fields.covers: Grouping only. Exact delområde names; the build fails on a typo.
fields.partial: Members the area only takes a piece of. Listed in the card, and drawn whole — over-covering an edge is more honest than a hole in the middle.
fields.within: Part only. The delområde it is inside.
fields.source: Where the extent came from. Every grouping has one; that is the point.
fields.note: Anything the source left open — read these before trusting an extent.
fields.lat/lon: Parts only, filled by the resolver. Edit freely.
fields.verified: Set true once you have looked at it on the map and agree with the extent. Everything below is false: it was assembled from sources, not from living here.

workflow: 2. node scripts/build-neighbourhoods.mjs --resolve   (fills missing points for parts)
3. Look at each area on the map; fix `covers` where it is wrong; set "verified": true.

areas.name: Slottsstaden
areas.note: Wikipedia: 'motsvarar ungefär delområdena Ribersborg, Malmöhus (sydvästra delen, Slottsparken), Hästhagen, Kronprinsen, Fågelbacken (norra delen) och Rönneholm (norra delen)'. The three partials are taken whole here.

areas.name: Limhamn
areas.note: Deliberately conservative: the old town, the harbour and the quarry. Limhamn is half of the stadsdel Limhamn-Bunkeflo and its eastern edge (Annetorp, Djupadal, Rosenvång?) is a matter of local usage, not of any source I could find. Owner call.

areas.name: Hamnen
areas.note: Malmö stad lists 'Malmö hamn' as one area. Västra Hamnen is deliberately excluded — it is its own place now, and is named separately on the map.

areas.name: Sofielund
areas.note: Split into Norra and Södra by the Malmö–Ystad railway in 1874; still one name in speech.

areas.name: Stadionområdet
areas.source: vardagligt namn; delområdet heter bara Stadion
areas.note: One member — this is a renaming, not a grouping: the area is spoken of as Stadionområdet.
